submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 3 cm thickness achieves the best pion/kaon separation performance with 4.6 sigma, which is 21% better than the second-best option (R3 at 3.8 sigma) and 59% better than R1 (2.9 sigma). All three radiator candidates pass the critical humidity ageing constraint (transparency loss < 10% after 10-year equivalent testing), making R2 a viable choice. The systematic evaluation across thicknesses from 1-6 cm confirms that 3 cm is optimal for R2, balancing sufficient radiator material for Cherenkov photon production while maintaining good optical performance. This configuration directly fulfills the goal of achieving the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
